title: Selective engineering of condensation properties of single-stranded DNA binding (SSB) protein via its intrinsically disordered linker region.
authors: Ecsedi, Peter; Erfalvy, David; Kovacs, Zoltan J; Katran, Viktoria; Palinkas, Janos; Cervenak, Miklos; Pancsa, Rita; Harami, Gabor M; Smeller, Laszlo; Kovacs, Mihaly
one_liner_zh: 该文通过工程改造大肠杆菌SSB蛋白的无序连接区调控其凝聚特性，并利用AlphaFold 3预测结构关联IDL构象动态，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作背景但核心聚焦蛋白凝聚而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法上AI结构预测可借鉴。
abstract: Single-stranded DNA binding (SSB) proteins are essential components of genome metabolism in both bacteria and eukaryotes. Recently demonstrated condensation propensities have placed SSB functions in a new context regarding the organization of nucleic acid-modifying complexes. In this work, we provide functional dissection of the condensation and partner binding properties of Escherichia coli (Ec) SSB via engineered modifications of its intrinsically disordered linker (IDL) region. We identify specific alterations in two glycine-rich regions as well as aromatic and/or positively charged residues of the IDL by which a broad-range, selective modification of condensation propensity and condensate thermal and chemical stability can be achieved, while leaving the single-stranded DNA and partner protein binding functions of SSB unchanged. AlphaFold 3-predicted structures of tetrameric wild-type and engineered EcSSB constructs identify multiple possible binding sites for the conserved C-terminal tip on the tetramer core of the IDL, establishing a link between condensation propensity and restrictions in IDL conformational dynamics. Besides defining the contributions of IDL-driven interactions to driving protein condensation, these results pave the way for the definition of in vivo roles of EcSSB condensation via genetic engineering and delineate ways for further development of liquid-liquid phase separation prediction algorithms.
abstract_zh: 单链DNA结合（SSB）蛋白是细菌和真核生物基因组代谢中的关键组分。近期展示的凝聚倾向将SSB功能置于核酸修饰复合物组织的新背景下。在本工作中，我们通过对大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli, Ec）SSB的内在无序连接区（intrinsically disordered linker, IDL）进行工程化修饰，对其凝聚及伴侣结合特性进行了功能解析。我们识别出IDL中两个富含甘氨酸区域以及芳香族和/或带正电荷残基的特异性改变，通过这些改变可实现凝聚倾向及凝聚物热稳定性和化学稳定性的广谱、选择性调节，同时保持SSB的单链DNA和伴侣蛋白结合功能不变。AlphaFold 3预测的四聚体野生型和工程化EcSSB结构揭示了保守C端尖端在IDL四聚体核心上的多个潜在结合位点，建立了凝聚倾向与IDL构象动力学限制之间的联系。除了定义IDL驱动相互作用在促进蛋白质凝聚中的贡献外，这些结果为通过遗传工程定义EcSSB凝聚的体内作用铺平了道路，并描绘了进一步开发液-液相分离预测算法的途径。
